summary: This is a Mol Labs public research report (card P8) proposing an assay to test whether FOXO4-DRI retains measurable senescent-cell (SC) kill under Bax/Bak loss-of-function (LOF) conditions that abolish navitoclax-mediated SC kill. The document is a hypothesis/prediction card with a negative status label, indicating the key experiment (matched Bax/Bak LOF residual FOXO4-DRI panel) has NOT been run. All critical experimental variables are either LITERATURE-sourced or classified as UNKNOWN/PREDICTION.

content_blocks.title: Claim / Hypothesis (P8)
content_blocks.content: On a matched senescent culture where Bax/Bak loss-of-function (or BAX-channel blockade) abolishes navitoclax senescent-cell kill (pre-registered navitoclax residual kill under LOF ≤20% of control-genotype navitoclax kill), FOXO4-DRI retains measurable residual SC kill — FOXO4-DRI kill under the same LOF ≥20% of its control-genotype FOXO4-DRI kill. This is a proposed assay (method: propose-assay), not a completed experiment. STATUS: NEGATIVE (not yet run).

content_blocks.title: Scientific Rationale / Mechanism Sketch
content_blocks.content: FOXO4-DRI enters via FOXO4–p53 axis; navitoclax acts via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w. Both may require Bax/Bak MOMP for execution, OR FOXO4-DRI may retain partial Bax-independent death routes when navitoclax is fully gated. The hypothesis tests whether distinct upstream entry (FOXO4–p53 vs. Bcl-2 family) translates to distinct downstream execution (Bax-independent vs. Bax-dependent MOMP). Endothelial FOXO4-DRI work frames a p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 cascade but lacks a Bax/Bak LOF residual-kill panel. Humanin–Bax MOMP block is cited as mechanism prior for BAX-channel tools, not as a FOXO4-DRI residual result.

content_blocks.title: Prior Art / Literature Evidence
content_blocks.content:
1. PMID 28340339 (Baar 2017, Cell, DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2017.02.031, PMC5556182): FOXO4-DRI perturbs FOXO4–p53 interaction → senescent-cell apoptosis. No Bax/Bak LOF residual arm.
2. PMID 41625068 (2025, Front. Bioeng. Biotechnol., DOI 10.3389/fbioe.2025.1729166, PMC12852416): Endothelial FOXO4-DRI framed via p53/BCL-2/Caspase-3 cascade. BCL-2/caspase cascade ≠ Bax/Bak LOF residual panel.
3. PMID 26711051 (Zhu 2016, DOI 10.1111/acel.12445, PMC4854923): Navitoclax (ABT-263) senolytic via Bcl-2/Bcl-xL/Bcl-w; cell-type restricted.
4. PMID 12732850 (Guo 2003, Nature, DOI 10.1038/nature01627): Humanin binds Bax; blocks mitochondrial translocation/cytochrome c release — MOMP-block prior, not FOXO4-DRI residual under LOF.

content_blocks.title: Baseline Measured / Evidence Status
content_blocks.content:
- FOXO4–p53 entry: LITERATURE (PMID 28340339)
- Downstream BCL-2/caspase framing: LITERATURE without Bax/Bak LOF residual (PMID 41625068)
- Navitoclax Bcl-2-family senolytic: LITERATURE (PMID 26711051)
- HN–Bax MOMP block: LITERATURE as mechanism prior (PMID 12732850)
- Matched Bax/Bak LOF (abolishing navitoclax) × residual FOXO4-DRI SC kill: UNKNOWN (soft-complete 0)
- Residual ≥20% of control-genotype FOXO4-DRI kill under LOF that abolishes navitoclax: PREDICTION
- P5–P7 do NOT already prove this residual.

content_blocks.title: Actionable Limitations
content_blocks.content:
1. Do not treat P5/P6/P7 as proving P8 — P7 left matched epistasis UNKNOWN and only flagged residual Bax-independence as a limitation; empty soft-complete ≠ demonstrated residual kill.
2. Gating condition is strong — assay requires LOF that abolishes the navitoclax arm first; partial navitoclax resistance misreads as FOXO4-DRI residual.
3. BCL-2 cascade ≠ Bax residual — PMID 41625068 implicates BCL-2/caspase nodes without genetic Bax/Bak necessity or residual measurement; alternate death routes remain PREDICTION until scored under the same LOF.

content_blocks.title: Refutation Criteria
content_blocks.content: On the pre-registered matched panel where Bax/Bak LOF/BAX-channel block abolishes navitoclax kill, if FOXO4-DRI residual kill also falls inside the null-residual band (FOXO4-DRI kill under LOF <20% of control-genotype, or inside band) — full MOMP-execution identity/≥ equal abolish survives and residual Bax-independence fails.

key_findings: P8 is a proposed assay (NOT_RUN) — no experimental data exists for the core claim; the matched Bax/Bak LOF × FOXO4-DRI residual SC kill panel has soft-complete score of 0 (UNKNOWN).
The hypothesis tests whether FOXO4-DRI retains ≥20% residual senescent-cell kill (relative to control-genotype) under Bax/Bak LOF conditions that abolish navitoclax kill (≤20% of control-genotype).

All supporting evidence is LITERATURE-derived: FOXO4–p53 entry (Baar 2017, PMID 28340339), BCL-2/caspase framing (PMID 41625068), navitoclax Bcl-2-family senolytic activity (Zhu 2016, PMID 26711051), and humanin–Bax MOMP block as mechanism prior (Guo 2003, PMID 12732850).
Critical epistasis experiment (matched Bax/Bak LOF abolishing navitoclax, then scoring FOXO4-DRI residual) is explicitly classified as UNKNOWN — no published or internal data found.
P5–P7 cards do not prove P8; P7 only flagged residual Bax-independence as a limitation without resolving it.
Estimated time to refute: 4 weeks; kill cost tier: 1 (low cost); FTO status: UNKNOWN.

Key methodological requirement: navitoclax abolish must be confirmed (≤20% of control-genotype kill) as a QC gate before FOXO4-DRI residual is scored; partial navitoclax resistance would confound results.
Document status is NEGATIVE — the claim is unproven and the experiment has not been run.
